name: Vriska Serket
source:
Vriska Serket, also known by her Trollian handle arachnidsGrip, is one of the trolls.

She has notoriously antagonistic tendencies. She gets easily bored, makes shady deals with people, hurts others, and then slams herself because she believes that nobody likes her. She has a tendency to manipulate those with low mental fortitude by using her mind control powers, and her abilities when accompanied with high emotions can lead to her taking things too far. She holds herself in high regard and often brags about herself. She does, however, have a softer and more benevolent side. She seems to have always felt bad about ending up as screwed up as she did as a result of troll culture, and laments how much better humans have it. She also has an obsession with the number eight, spiders, and pirates.

Her associated zodiac sign is Scorpio. She is of blue blood caste.

[From [url=https://mspaintadventures.fandom.com/wiki/Vriska_Serket]MSPA Wiki[/url]]
